title: Analyzing School District Reading Scores
author: Trinity Harden
execute:
  echo: false

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2015 = rla_score) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_dist |>
      filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
      select(district_id, rla_2023 = rla_score      ),
      by = "district_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()

state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015 = rla_score) |>
  inner_join(
      tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
        filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
        select(stateabb, rla_2023 = rla_score),
      by = "stateabb"
  ) |>
  mutate(score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  mutate(rla_change = score_change) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = after_stat(x >= 0))) +
  geom_histogram(boundary = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#D55E00", "TRUE" = "#0072B2"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Negative", "TRUE" = "Positive")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in District Reading Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with data in both years:", nrow(score_change)),
    x = "Reading score change (2023 minus 2015)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; negative values indicate decline."
  )
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  mutate(
    state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, rla_2023),
    direction = if_else(rla_2023 >= rla_2015, "Positive", "Negative")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = rla_2015, xend = rla_2023, yend = state_name, color = direction),
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches"))
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray60") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#D55E00", "Positive" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores: 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows show the direction and size of each state's score change",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Change",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrowheads mark 2023 scores."
  )
```
